annotation.title_clean: Comisión de Educación Superior analiza matriz comparativa del proyecto de ley para regular el uso de inteligencia artificial
annotation.title_en: Higher Education Commission reviews comparative matrix of the bill to regulate the use of artificial intelligence
annotation.summary_en: Senate news item reporting that the Dominican Senate's Higher Education, Science and Technology Commission continued reviewing a comparative matrix of a bill on ethical and safe AI use. The bill sets a cross-sector legal framework balancing innovation with human dignity and rights, and the commission will invite institutions such as ITLA and OGTIC.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bill establishes a comprehensive legal framework for developing, deploying, using and supervising AI systems across all sectors
Aims to promote responsible AI without unnecessary restrictions on innovation
Protects human dignity, personal autonomy, equality and constitutional rights
Seeks legal certainty and public trust
Commission will invite ITLA, INFOTEP, OGTIC to contribute at next meeting
